scientific.role: Prospective availability-conditional final reservation; distinct new protocol, not completion/replacement of original40vs200 input-negative campaign
scientific.selection_rule: SHA256 UTF8("GeoBC prospective CAD split v1|"+CAD) ascending, CAD tie; first20 FINAL,next60 additionalTRAIN,remaining reserve. No label or model-performance selection.
scientific.scaler_policy: For a future40vs100 coverage comparison retain the original TRAIN40-only scaler; no DEV/FINAL fit. Other experiments require a separately frozen TRAIN-only policy.
scientific.FINAL_policy: Do not parse numerical FINAL CSV/H5 fields, generate target caches, train or tune on FINAL. Geometry-only preparation needs a separately frozen target-free producer. All selected models must submit complete finite60 predictions or honest failures before one shared FINAL readout.
scientific.former_protocol: Original source540/input660/prediction2400 campaign SCI and fixed IDs remain unchanged/negative; do not restart original training200 because its proposed TRAIN includes the newly reservedFINAL.
interpretation_limits: OfficialTRAIN-pool availability conditional, not officialTEST/unbiased population sample
Identity-disjoint CADs; shape-family separation not demonstrated
Reservation is supported by tracked prepared-manifest/readout history, not a claim about every external human/file read
Existing binary reception SHA is not independent upstream checksum; current stats checked without rereading raw bytes
No numerical labels/models/arrays used to choose IDs; metadata may reference previously known targets that are conservatively excluded
